violations.text: During inspection, there was no one present who was certified as a food safety manager. There must be an on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

Eggs were observed held at 66 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC moved eggs to cooler. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026
Inspector observed exposed rodent bait. Rodent bait must be maintained in a rodent bait station. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026
Inspector observed glue trap under deli display cooler with dead roaches. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

The following was not in good repair: - Steam Table (water dripping observed) - Deli Display Unit (Ambient of 45 F) - 3 Door Retail Cooler (Ambient 45 F) - Produce Walk-In Cooler (Ambient 51 F) No TCS items were observed at time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: - pots and pans (accumulation of burnt grease/food) - containers (old labels) New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

The dumpster outside is located on rocks. The outdoor storage surface for refuse, recyclables, and returnables must be constructed of nonabsorbent material such as concrete or asphalt and must be smooth, durable, and sloped to drain. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026

The floor under the steam table has an accumulation of old rodent droppings and other debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026
The hand-washing sinks in the meat cutting area and bathroom were lacking paper towels. PIC replaced. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026
Inspector observed two oranges with mold in the produce walk-in cooler. PIC discarded. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (slicers and ban saw) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC took units out of service to be washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

Beans and pork were observed held between 123-129 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC reheated and turned up hot-hold unit. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

Various items (cheese, potato salad, pasta salad) were observed held between 45-47 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC moved items to another cooler for active cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

Various frozen items (chocolate covered banana with peanuts, chocolate covered bread, and various milk based ice pops) packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. PIC relocated items to a non-grab and go freezer. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

The presence of small flies, cockroaches, and rodents are not controlled as evidenced by live small flies, live cockroaches, and small rodent droppings. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026
Inspector observed frozen chicken uncovered in freezer unit. PIC covered. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026
The sink used for food preparation is lacking an air gap. Current setup has an air break Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026

The dumpster outside is located on rocks. The outdoor storage surface for refuse, recyclables, and returnables must be constructed of nonabsorbent material such as concrete or asphalt and must be smooth, durable, and sloped to drain Repeat Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026

Chocolate covered banana and bread packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name and address. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026
The sink used for food preparation is lacking an air gap. Current setup has an air break. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026

The dumpster outside is located on rocks. The outdoor storage surface for refuse, recyclables, and returnables must be constructed of nonabsorbent material such as concrete or asphalt and must be smooth, durable, and sloped to drain. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026
The Person in charge did not assure compliance with critical code requirements. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026
Menu lacks allergen statement. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026
The hand-washing sinks in the kitchen and bathroom were lacking hand washing signage. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (knife and food processor blade) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

The chlorine concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was 10 parts per million (ppm). The concentration of chlorine in the sanitizing solution must be between 50-100 ppm. PIC added chlorine and retested. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

Ground beef, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. PIC discarded. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

Various TCS items were observed held between 114-130 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC reheated. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

Various TCS items were observed held between 45-57 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. PIC disposed of or moved products based on time/temp and risk. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Inspector observed ground beef in the 2 door cooler in a container greater than 4 inches with plastic wrap and lid cooling from the previous day. PIC disposed of item. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

Various self service items packaged in the food establishment are lacking labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients, the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

The door to the outside, located in the dining area, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026
Inspector observed cat in basement area of establishment. Inspector informed owner to remove cat from establishment. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026
Flour bag was observed stored on the floor in the bakery area. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026
Inspector observed chocolate covered bananas and chocolate covered bread without protection in customer self serving ice cream freezer. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026
Inspector observed containers stored on floor in kitchen area. PIC informed that equipment must be stored at least 6 inches off the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026
Blender and food processor were not properly air dried. Inspector observed an accumulation of water in equipment. PIC washed/sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

Cardboard is used in the construction of shelf liners in the beverage cooler. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

Wood is used in the construction of shelves in the produce walk-in cooler. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026
Inspector observed the following in poor repair: - walk-in cooler (ambient 58 F) - 3 door cooler (ambient 47 F) New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026
The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: - knife rack - 2 door meat freezer New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026
Inspector observed no hot water available at hand sink in bakery area. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026
Inspector observed a drip at prep sink. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026

The sink used for food preparation is lacking an air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026
The doors to the toilet rooms are not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026
The receptacle toilet room is lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 05/26/2026

The dumpster outside is located on dirt. The outdoor storage surface for refuse, recyclables, and returnables must be constructed of nonabsorbent material such as concrete or asphalt and must be smooth, durable, and sloped to drain. New Violation. Correct By: 06/02/2026
Inspector observed a heavy accumulation of pallets and other debris around dumpster area. Area to be maintained clean. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the basement and meat cutting areas. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 06/30/2026

The following areas have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. - kitchen hood vents - walk-in cooler fan covers - walk-in cooler ceiling/walls - basement floor around grease trap - wall behind knife rackThe physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026
The wall in the dining area AND produce walk-in cooler is in poor repair (hole observed). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 05/19/2026
